reviews.author: ji young kim
reviews.text: Under Bar Seoul is a great place to visit on special days and enjoy wine and quality cuisine! The owner is very friendly and the atmosphere is so nice... I want to come again next time🩷 All the dishes were delicious so I had a great time! I visited for a birthday party and it was a really nice choice! I recommend it🫡👍

reviews.author: jinhee kim
reviews.text:
If you have to choose a place you must visit when you come to Haebangchon, I highly recommend Under Bar Seoul! I visited for brunch with a friend, and from the moment I went up to the second floor, I was greeted by an open view of Namsan Mountain. The interior is a space full of emotion, with a vintage mood and warm lighting. The panoramic view and the jazz sound coming from the wood speakers complete the romantic atmosphere, so I naturally stayed here leisurely. It was so relaxing!

The two of us were very satisfied with the brunch menu as well. The raw noodle butter cacio pepe was very satisfying because it had a balanced texture of soft raw noodle, the nutty flavor of butter and cheese, and the flavor of pepper, and the lamb tomato stew was a good combination of soft lamb and fresh tomato flavor without any unpleasant smell, so it was hearty and easy to enjoy!  I definitely recommend the mini whole apple pie I had for dessert. The combination of the warm pie and vanilla ice cream went so well with the view of Namsan💛

You can 200% enjoy a leisurely brunch restaurant during the day and a wine bar with a nice atmosphere at night. The menu, atmosphere, and service are all satisfactory, so it's a great place to visit with friends or lovers!! If you come to Haebangchon, I highly recommend stopping by ❤️

reviews.author: Jang Chae-eun
reviews.text:
I was impressed by the warm and cozy mood that unfolded the moment I opened the door.
The lighting and music selection were great, and the vintage audio speakers were perfect.
The space is also sensational, so every space is a photo zone ✨
There were various bar tables and general seating, so it was great for enjoying some time alone, chatting with friends, or even for a date.

The signature dish here is French toast.
I haven't tried it, so I plan to try it again later😭

reviews.author: Hayoung Ja
reviews.text: After eating at Shinheung Market, I visited Underbar Seoul, which offers wine bars, cafes, and even brunch. ᐟ I had to go to a cafe again later this day, so I skipped the drinks, but the dessert taste was sweet and good, and I was able to enjoy both the day and night sunsets of Haebangchon through the glass. The ambience and music of the store were also good. I recommend visiting when you go on a date at Haebangchon.

reviews.author: SEOU CHOI
reviews.text: Haebangchon Underbar Seoul is a place where the panoramic view of Seoul is the best. You can enjoy a leisurely brunch during the day and wine with a spectacular night view at night. The stylish interior run by a design studio and the music playing from a vintage audio system from the 80s add to the charm of the space. The baguette French toast and raw noodle cacio pepe were really delicious, and the earl gray ade was also unique and good. Highly recommended for a date or gathering on a special day!

reviews.author: Hong Duik
reviews.text: The food is larger than expected, and the contents are generous and delicious. The seasoning was a bit strong, but I like spicy food, so it was delicious. The egg dishes were generally good and the pasta was delicious, Korean style with lots of garlic flavor. The coffee goes well with brunch, and you can refill it during the week. It takes a while for the food to come out, but when I received it, it seemed like it would take a long time. Rotation is quite slow.

reviews.author: Jiyeon Min
reviews.text:
I came to Haebangchon on a date and had brunch!
I visited this place because it had a lot of variety and was good, and I was very satisfied.
The American breakfast was good to eat with moist and soft pancakes, fried eggs, ham, bacon, potatoes, etc. I think it's the representative menu and it was really delicious.
I was surprised that the burrata tomato pasta tasted better than I expected as the fresh burrata cheese and tomato sauce went well together.
Apple Mangoade has a strong mango flavor and is refreshing and sweet!
Chamomile tea was refreshing and good to enjoy with brunch.
If you are looking for a delicious brunch restaurant in Haebangchon
I recommend Maple House😊

reviews.author: Hyunhee Jeon
reviews.text:
This is a famous steamed pancake restaurant in Haebangchon.👍
I ordered the signature American breakfast and avocado toss. The pancakes here were seriously so delicious😊 They are fluffy, thick, and soft, so I think they taste better than pancakes in the US.
The avocado toast is a toast filled with avocado, topped with a poached egg, bursting the yolk, and sprinkling a little lemon on it. It's refreshing and so delicious that I kept eating it even though I was full.
This place is truly delicious, even the latte😂 I went today and already want to go again.
There was so much food that two women were eating it and our stomachs were full.
The atmosphere of the store had a cute American feel and the music was great. I recommend Haebangchon as a great place for brunch.

reviews.author: Hyunsoo Nam
reviews.text:
The atmosphere is good and the sensibility is good, so it's great for a date!!
Overall, I felt good because the food was delicious!
The best part is that you can bring your pet with you!!

reviews.author: Summer
reviews.text: I was walking around Haebangchon and found all the coffee shops I wanted to go to so I went in. The atmosphere was nice and the food was good haha.

reviews.author: NAHZ
reviews.text:
1. This place has the best soup and salt bread.
2. The atmosphere is nice and the taste is good. There are a lot of them.
3. Even if you go in the morning, the waiting line is quite long. (based on weekends)

reviews.author: john Dejong
reviews.text:
Opato, famous for its salt bread
A bakery and a cafe famous for brunch, where waiting is a must, face each other.
After eating too much at the taco stand, I bought just one salt bread and tried it, but it was as good as I heard.
No matter how you say it, salt bread...
It would be nice to come out early on the weekend and have brunch at a cafe.

reviews.author: Dewani Cage
reviews.text:
A brunch restaurant and bakery run together in a narrow alley. It is famous for salt bread and baguettes. The store's strength is its cozy interior, reminiscent of one found in an old European town. The food didn't meet my expectations, but the atmosphere was great so it's worth a visit at least once.

The baguette sandwich (15,000 won) was good with plenty of high-quality cheese, ham, arugula, and honey, but I was disappointed that the baguette I was looking forward to was tougher than I expected. The outside was nice and crispy, but the inside was tough and difficult to chew. It has a sweet taste because it contains honey. The taste wasn't anything special, and the Americano (5,000 won) was extremely average.

There was no wait at the brunch restaurant on a weekday morning, and the place was quite full by 10:30.

The salt bread (4,000 won) sold at the bakery was as good as its reputation, but the baked goods were a bit expensive compared to their size. They mainly sell meal breads such as baguettes, ciabatta, whole wheat sticks, and pretzels, and although the variety is not diverse, they seem to be focused on the items they are good at.

reviews.author: Sheed Yoo
reviews.text:
A bakery and brunch cafe with an atmosphere reminiscent of a cafe located in a corner of a European alley.

It seems that its true value is revealed even more as it expands from a bakery to a brunch restaurant.

Everything was perfect, from the neatly cleaned glass cups to the props, the atmosphere of the store, the servers, and the food and drinks. I wanted to try all the other dishes, but I was disappointed that I visited alone. I recommend going with a group of people to taste the food together.

reviews.author: CH Song
reviews.text: It's a famous salt bread restaurant, so we went there at 1pm on a weekday and the plain version was sold out. The brunch was delicious, but the Pto was quite sweet.

reviews.author: Immeari (sea seal)
reviews.text: It has one floor, two floors, and three floors, and many of the employees are foreigners. Everyone is friendly. I wonder if the owner is also a foreigner. The menu is clean and the view is fantastic, especially from the rooftop. It is a place where you can see the city and the Seoul Tower.

reviews.author: Yoon Joo-sik
reviews.text:
Interior - The interior is simple and clean.
View - Good view of Seoul from the 2nd and 3rd floors
Food - All three foods have a strong salty taste, so I call for a drink. I especially crave carbonation, but there is no carbonation.

reviews.author: chaerin yoo
reviews.text: I'm a bit disappointed by the poor quality compared to the price. Coffee and banoffee pie taste fantastic. Naverz's atmosphere and service are very good. The space itself is painted and has a nice view, so I can go there every day for coffee, but I don't think I'll order food again. I expected it to be a brunch menu prepared by the famous Bangbang, but it may have been expensive because it is a new market, but the taste was very normal compared to the price. The salmon toast and shakshuka are of decent taste, and Naver's hotcakes are 25,000 won, but the pancake taste is really no different from other places. Nevertheless, the banoffee pie is impeccably delicious and the coffee is also good. When I visited for the second time a week later, the price of Banoffee Pie went up by 1,000 won. Hmm, it's still delicious, so I'll go for coffee and pie.

reviews.author: Jo Young-ju
reviews.text:
This is a place I stopped by for coffee after eating at Shinheung Market. It's a brunch place, but you can only drink coffee.
The full-length windows on the 2nd and 3rd floors offer a refreshing view, and the rough-style interior matches well with the Shinheung Market.
I ordered the Cafe Latte Flat White Banoffee Pie, and the coffee has a strong, nutty flavor, so I recommend it to people who like Australian-style coffee.
There are several types of desserts, and I highly recommend Banoffee Pie. The pie crust is crunchy and the combination of dolce de leche and banana is great.
I enjoyed my coffee and left~

reviews.author: EY J
reviews.text:
Haebangchon Shinheung Market’s popular brunch cafe, Navers, and Sunset View Bistro are fun to visit~~
A new market that fills an old, worn-out market space with a unique and lively atmosphere. It's a place I want to visit several times and try all the good restaurants and bars. It's nice to be able to relax while drinking a delicious beer while watching the sunset through the full-length window.

reviews.author: Jo
reviews.text: All of the menu items were very delicious, but had a simple, home-cooked taste. However, the poached eggs on top of the food were so overcooked that they were not poached eggs. The store is located inside, at the end of a slightly high staircase, so the sun comes in well, creating a warm feeling. A little cold.

reviews.author: Gogi Ram
reviews.text:
A restaurant on Gyeongnidan-gil that I have visited at least 20 times.
The owner is so kind and most of all, the food is delicious!!
All types of Benedict are delicious, and if you fall in love with the monthly menu that changes every month, this is a place you'll go to 12 times a year.
Not only is the food delicious, but the coffee is also delicious!

reviews.author: 1st C
reviews.text: It's in a small place up the hill on Gyeongnidan-gil that doesn't seem like there's anything there. There's a wait and it's delicious without being overpowering.

reviews.author: Kyobin Koo
reviews.text:
A brunch place called “Sunday Afternoon.”
In good weather, the lighting is good and the interior is filled with natural light. It's great for taking pictures and the atmosphere is warm.
Dishes using poached eggs (Benedict, etc.) are excellent, and the harmony of taste and color in all menus is excellent. It's not excessive, but it's faithful and harmonious.
The kindness of the young owner and the occasional conversation between foreigners liven up the atmosphere.

I highly recommend visiting early on a sunny day!

reviews.author: YUNA CHUNG
reviews.text:
It's in an alley and parking is difficult, but somehow I feel like I've found a good restaurant.
The eggs Benedict had a strong mustard taste, which made it a bit uncomfortable, and the bread was dry.
Still, I had a pleasant meal with neat food and a beautiful atmosphere.

reviews.author: Alma Curiosa
reviews.text:
It has a small but cute and hip interior with the name Ptodak, Master of Life, and consists of 1 table for 4 people, 2 tables for 2 people, and bar seating. 3 staff (1 minute cooking). Friendly and delicious. Pto chicken with a mysteriously delicious sweet and salty taste. (Next time I'll just have to try the French toast) The pistachio potato gratin is also delicious! For two people, two menus may not be enough, but if we order one additional menu, we will be a little full. (Please develop a side!)

If the timing is right, there is no waiting, and even if you wait, it is worth the wait.

reviews.author: Kai Lee
reviews.text:
Noksapyeong Brunch Bar Hemian
A brunch bar with a hip atmosphere. I ordered Pto Chicken (French Toast + Chicken Legs) for dinner and was surprised at how well the sweet and salty went together. Since the owner operates alone, I was worried that there might be a delay in ordering or cooking, but the store is running well. I want to try other menus as well.

reviews.author: Joanne Lee
reviews.text: This is the place that Chat gpt recommended as the best French toast restaurant in Itaewon! We had an open run on Sunday morning. The food was delicious and the staff were friendly. However, it was a bit disappointing that the tables filled up quickly, and the spacing between the tables was narrow and the counter was close, so it wasn't a leisurely brunch!

reviews.author: Chanho Andrew Kim (MUYO)
reviews.text: While looking for a place to eat early in the morning in Itaewon, I found a brunch restaurant and visited it a little after 10 o'clock. I ordered French toast and pistachio potato gratin. The French toast was a crispy brownie baked in butter and caramelized sugar, so it had a crisp and moist texture that was beyond reproach. The gratin was made by mixing potatoes, onions, and ham with cream and mozzarella cheese, baking it in the oven, and finishing it with pistachio powder. I liked the unique shape and rich taste, but I wish it had a little more greasiness. I think this is a brunch restaurant that is competitive enough with its French toast alone.

reviews.author: hot Gaji
reviews.text:
Pistachio potato gratin. It was a combination I had never tried before, so I enjoyed it. French toast tastes just like we know.
I sat in front of the door, but there was an open kitchen + people waiting closely watching what I was eating. It was a bit burdensome because it was very close. If you go at a time when there are less people, you can feel the unique cool atmosphere of Hemian. Coffee refills are available.

reviews.author: Dosa Almond
reviews.text:
I really like the fact that there is a brunch cafe and bakery run by a pastry major with solid baking experience on Gyeongnidan-gil.
It seems that competitors are already emerging to purchase healthy breads.
From brunch to dessert, it is a completely healthy meal.

reviews.author: Eric song
reviews.text: A place where you can have a healthy and delicious brunch in a calm atmosphere. Kindness is also a bonus.

reviews.author: Polina Galina
reviews.text: The food is delicious and the staff are really friendly. The atmosphere is also great. Delicious-looking bread is also sold packaged. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sébastien Ferrarini
reviews.text: Great quality and elegance are the order of the day in this pleasant, calm and quiet little space. I really liked it! Bravo, thank you.

reviews.author: Yonghyun Kim
reviews.text: very good

reviews.author: Sunghyuk Park
reviews.text:
As this place is run by a German chef, the quality of the bread was solid. In particular, the original scent of the bakery filled the store, making it feel like I was in a real bakery.
The tomato soup exceeded my expectations. I liked the freshness and deep flavor as if it had just been boiled. The currywurst is a traditional German sausage that goes well with the curry sauce and seems to go well with beer. The Farmer had a generous brunch menu, and it was nice to be able to choose how the eggs were cooked. The brunch menu was closer to a typical brunch rather than German style.
The inside of the store is small and can be a bit chaotic on weekends as there are a lot of customers and there is a waiting line. However, the staff provided quick and accurate service, so the inconvenience of waiting was not significant.
Next time I plan to visit again just to buy bread.

reviews.author: Yeohwi
reviews.text:
Today’s lunch is at a delicious brunch cafe~~

A few people had already been there and said that the bread was especially delicious. When I previewed the menu, I was full of anticipation.

This is my first time going to this place, so I ordered a lot of different things! Haha
Both soups were good, but I especially liked the slightly sour tomato soup, and the onion soup was just what I liked.

I was surprised that the potatoes that came with the schnitzel were unexpectedly delicious! Sausages are the best!! I ordered the curry wurst and was very satisfied with it as it was my personal favorite dish. I ate a very large meal with one menu per person, sides, and soup. I was very full.

The food came out quickly and the service was good, so this is a place I want to visit again next time! A pleasant lunch is the best gift for office workers. I ate well~

reviews.author: Woochan Lee
reviews.text:
This is a restaurant where you can taste good schnitzel in Seoul.
It was my first time trying German schnitzel, but it was good and not greasy.

reviews.author: Minwoo Kim
reviews.text:
A special cafe that makes you feel like you are traveling to Europe even though it is Korea.
All the employees are foreigners, and there are many foreign customers as well.
For a moment, I felt like I was in another country.
The bread and coffee taste great,
The location of the store was great, and even the view outside was very pretty.
The atmosphere, taste, and scenery were all satisfactory.

reviews.author: Abigail Lee
reviews.text:
It's been a while since I visited Baker's Table.
Breads like hard rolls and pretzels are delicious!
However, cheesecakes and other dessert breads with custard are not to Korean tastes... Just think of it as adding a little sweetness and sourness to the texture of soboro bread. The bottom sheet of the cheesecake doesn't feel like cookie crumbles, but like soboro bread. (If that's the case, wouldn't dessert be removed from the menu? ㅠ)

The thing that tastes worse than anything else is the schnitzel... I always knew that bread was better than brunch. The schnitzel skin is thicker than that of Korean pork cutlets, and the skin is peeled because the frying temperature is not properly controlled; ㅠ It really didn't taste good..

The soup is delicious when dipped in hard rolls or other bread. It has a watery texture and isn't bad when slurped down with bread.

Recommended if you want to buy ‘bread’ such as baguettes, hard rolls, or pretzels,,
Other desserts are not recommended
Not recommended for any meals or brunch other than soups and sandwiches.
The staff tries to be friendly, but lacks basic sense. Still, thank you for your efforts abroad~~

I'll probably come back just to buy the hard rolls or pretzels...

P.S. I said the schnitzel was not tasty, but the owner commented brightly... You said there was a problem with your schnitzel.

reviews.author: Dewani Cage
reviews.text: Focaccia restaurant. The coffee is pretty good and the cozy atmosphere is nice. The omelette had a slightly fishy smell, which was disappointing, and the dressing on the mini salad seemed a bit ambiguous as well. It's not something you'll come to from far away, but it's a good place for brunch if you live nearby. The owner is very kind.

reviews.author: mikazella
reviews.text: Although it is not easy to get to, it is a place full of reasons to visit! The food tastes so good and the owner is so friendly! Even the music playing in the store is relaxing ❤️ And there's Hako, the cute dog, so it's a lovely space where you can indulge yourselves! 🩵Chicken radish cream! Be sure to eat it~!! If you eat it as is and add a drop or two of Tabasco sauce in the middle, you can enjoy a different flavor!! :-) I will visit often!!

reviews.author: ALLDAY MUSIC
reviews.text:
It's a good place to eat for breakfast nearby. The atmosphere is warm and, above all, the owner is very friendly.
The menu is sincere and simple.

reviews.author: J
reviews.text: It was comfortable and delicious, and I felt like it was good for my body while eating it. It's soft and luxurious.

reviews.author: in B
reviews.text:
Mausi Signature Latte is very delicious! It's savory and sweet, but it's not overwhelming and it's an addictive taste...!
Coffee of life
For dessert, the cheesecake and earl gray lemon scone were also good.

reviews.author: wpzl H
reviews.text: It's quiet because it's located a bit further from Shinheung Market. I liked that the menu was varied.

reviews.author: youkyung noh
reviews.text: It was so delicious. It's friendly and especially the creamy mushroom pasta, which is a common menu item, but it's especially delicious and memorable. The atmosphere is great and I recommend it!!

reviews.author: Chanho Andrew Kim (MUYO)
reviews.text: Contrary to its name, it is a wonderful brunch cafe where you can enjoy a brunch that is absolutely not normal. It is a talented cafe that considers itself to be a “brunch cafe that cooks,” which I think is the highest rating among brunch cafes. It is the second restaurant that made me think that gnocchi is “delicious,” and I think it will be more memorable because it is the restaurant that made me think that fried Western-style chicken is better than chicken. Among brunch restaurants, the menu is diverse and the menu changes seasonally, so it's a great restaurant you'll want to bring to the neighborhood and one you'll likely visit often in the future.

reviews.text: High quality foods and they have a rooftop!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Isa Dor
reviews.text:
It's always an amazing pleasure to be able to enjoy fantastic and delicious vegan bakery cakes without worrying about suffering from casein intolerance.
Plus, the vegan cafe has a clean, refreshing atmosphere and is full of sweet chocolate scent, so I really like it! 😋❤️❤️❤️

reviews.text: Delicious and cozy space right off the main street of HBC

reviews.author: TA O
reviews.text: It's a great place to enjoy coffee and pastries. The view is great and the staff are friendly.

reviews.author: S L
reviews.text:
Vegetus in Haebangchon was really tasty! Not so cheap but good price with big portion. Ah Lasagne was expensive and seemed small... but was super delicious so. Whatever. Burrito bowl was amazing, caprese panini and bolognese good and everyone else said that thr burger was really good but I was busy eating other stuff closer to me and forgot to try it... have to go back!! .
.
.
Haebangchon Begetus. It was smaller than I thought, but it had a spacious dining table and the interior was cutely decorated. Above all, the food was all delicious!! Especially the burrito bowl! The portions are plentiful and delicious! The lasagna was delicious, but I ordered it late so I don't have a picture...? They say they used dried tofu instead of noodles, but when it's warm, it's as soft as plain noodles, doesn't even taste like tofu, and the sauce is really delicious. This is not a large quantity compared to the price (1.7). The Caprese Panini with pesto was delicious and the bolognese was also good! They said the burger was delicious, but I forgot to eat it because I was busy eating other things. ㅠㅠ I'll have to go again next time. The hot chocolate was thick, but so-so, and the cake was all good. For me, it was carrot cake>banana bread>chocolate cake, but it seemed like everyone else had banana bread>chocolate>carrots..

reviews.author: Dillisus
reviews.text:
One of the few restaurants in the country that offers vegan food
The CEO here is an acquaintance, so when he comes to Seoul from time to time,
This is one of the best restaurants you can visit.
All the food made here is delicious, but personally,
I recommend Begetus Burger.
And the owner here is really beautiful!! 😄

reviews.author: Hyanga
reviews.text:
The cilantro sauce inside the Begetus Burger is a kick.
French fries are the best.

reviews.author: Jeong JeongHeejeong Hui jeong
reviews.text: The Begetus Burger and lasagna were both delicious, and the carrot cake was delicious without being too sweet! It was a healthy, tasty and satisfying meal.

reviews.author: user
reviews.text: The price was a bit high and the quantity seemed small, but I was satisfied in the end when I ate it all. The taste was enough to make me feel like it was worth it after coming a long way. Hamburgers may be uncomfortable to eat, but they will be much easier to eat if you don't stick to the shape of the burger or the original way of eating it (eating the bread ingredients all at once).

reviews.author: Taemi Lee
reviews.text:
I happened to visit Baidubu while on a pilgrimage to Bbangji.
A restaurant where tofu gangjeong is better than seasoned chicken.
I ordered broccoli tofu stew, soup, and English breakfast.
Broccoli tofu gangjeong. Baked in the oven to make the tofu and sauce more crispy on the outside,
I chewed the fresh broccoli with a little bit of lime vinegar sauce on it, and the quinoa, kamut, red onion, corn, and black beans were tasty and healthy.
The cheese-like thing on top is soy mayo, which is really delicious when dipped in vegetables and tofu.
You can enjoy a variety of flavors in one bowl.
I thought the bowl I had at Crackin was the best I've ever had... but this one is the best.
The soup was light and delicious. A tasteful olive oil added to the soup.
It's really, really delicious and the inside is really pretty.

reviews.author: Chanho Andrew Kim (MUYO)
reviews.text: This is a vegan restaurant that serves a variety of dishes using vegan ingredients. Even during opening hours, the store was packed with customers, which gave me a sense that it was a famous restaurant. I ordered BTS (Thai Salad), Baidubu Wrap, and Baidubu Hummus. The BTS came with a generous amount of various vegetables and nuts, which went well with the Thai-style sauce. The roasted pecans added a particularly nutty flavor, and the cilantro served with cilantro gave it a Thai feel. The tofu wrap, along with vegetables, tofu chips, and carrot wrap, was delicious as it went well with the spicy taste of the Mexican-style sauce. They serve chipotle mayo for those who think the seasoning is a bit weak, but the chipotle mayo tastes great on its own, so I'm considering buying it separately. Actually, I visited because I wanted to try hummus, and it went well with the toasted bread that came with it. It's been a while since I visited this place with the intention of having a healthy(?) meal, and I was satisfied because it exceeded my expectations. It's a friendly restaurant that I would visit often if it were near my house.

reviews.author: Dewani Cage
reviews.text:
A vegan restaurant that sells salads, sandwiches, wraps, and more. Tofu Gangjeong Bowl consists of tofu gangjeong, which tastes like Chinese cuisine, and a huge amount of broccoli and leafy vegetables. The tofu gangjeong was unique, but it was a bit disappointing that it was served cold.

In addition, all menu items, including the tempeh-filled wrap sandwich and the egg-less sandwich, are healthy and fresh. The quantity is large. The cookies sold as a side menu are also quite delicious.

reviews.author: Nana
reviews.text:
The food is unique to Baidubu and is delicious and plentiful!
I ordered 2 pieces, but it was like 3 servings for 2 people. The hand washing area is inside the restaurant and the bathroom is outside! It opens early in the morning, closes at 5, and last order is at 4:30pm, so if you go for a late lunch, popular menu items are often sold out, so I recommend going early!

reviews.author: Cho Ara
reviews.text: I really like this place😆 Not only the main menu items such as tofu wrap, broccoli gangjeong, and badu banh mi, but also all kinds of rice-based bakeries are delicious🥰 Vegan dishes, a space for pets, and I really like the fact that they care about the environment! I will wait for the remodeling to be completed and business to resume again~~~

reviews.author: Yeon Woo Kim
reviews.text:
This is the house that appeared in Kim Young-cheol's Around the Neighborhood Itaewon episode.
This is a croissant restaurant.
However, if croissants are so special that you have to go and eat them, that's not true. There are many places where croissants are delicious.
